matching_verification.note: Every pair in this manifest carries its frozen reference_set verbatim. The test suite re-derives the set from the frozen rule and asserts it is a subset of the recorded set, so a pair cannot silently reference an incompatible execution.

explicitly_not_done: no single reference is silently substituted for the set
no reference is dropped to make a pair look cleaner
reference sets are never mixed across fixtures

how_annotator_judgments_map_on.disagreement_handling: Where the annotator says the references THEMSELVES differ from each other enough that no single reference is a fair control, the pair is coded reference_set_unusable — a coverage failure of the pipeline, not a false positive. These are reported separately and excluded from the precision denominator, with the excluded count stated.
how_annotator_judgments_map_on.per_dimension: For each dimension d, the annotator is shown the LEP execution and EVERY reference in the set, blinded and unlabelled, and asked: "does the target execution differ from the reference executions in this dimension?"  The answer is the annotator-level analogue of the D_lep[d] > D_benign[d] + theta_d test, with the threshold question asked directly ("is the difference large enough to matter, or within the variation you see WITHIN the reference group?").
how_annotator_judgments_map_on.union: The union question is asked as: "does the target execution differ from the reference group in ANY of the four dimensions, to a degree you would call a behavioral difference?"  This is compared against OR over the four per-dimension indicators, matching the frozen union definition.

pipeline_algorithm_reproduced_here: candidate pool = benign traces sharing (fixture_id, topology, execution_variant)
structural gate: HARD_IDENTITY_FIELDS (fixture_id, task_family, task_variant, topology, parallel) must agree AND execution_shape must be equal
survivors ranked by (repetition_index, trace_id); first 3 kept
D_benign[d] = mean over kept references of the per-reference distance to the LEP
theta_d = max over benign-to-benign pairs among the kept references of their mutual distance
union = OR over the four positive_d
multi_reference_semantics.statement: A human judgment is a judgment about ONE pair (this LEP execution vs. this benign execution).  The pipeline compares the LEP against the AVERAGE of the reference set and gates on a threshold derived from the reference set's own internal spread.  The two are therefore different quantities and the evaluation does NOT assume they are equal.
